sources.name: load
sources.cmd: F={{state}}/tide/today.json; if [ -s "$F" ]; then cat "$F"; else printf 'null'; fi

sources.name: save
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/tide; mkdir -p "$D/archive"; A="$HATCH_ARG"; OP="${A%% *}"; DATA="${A#* }"; case "$OP" in *:*) ID="${OP#*:}"; OP="${OP%%:*}";; *) ID=;; esac; case "$ID" in '') F="$D/today.json";; [0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]) F="$D/archive/$ID.json";; *) echo "bad day id" >&2; exit 1;; esac; T="$F.hatch-tmp"; case "$OP" in B) printf '%s' "$DATA" > "$T";; A) printf '%s' "$DATA" >> "$T";; C) mv "$T" "$F" || exit 1;; *) echo 'unknown save step' >&2; exit 1;; esac; printf '{"ok":true}'
